plugins.name: Quick Point Dropper

plugins.notes: After install: CloudTAK Settings → Refresh App.

plugins.name: HelloWorld
plugins.description: Official CloudTAK plugin sample (index.ts at repo root).
plugins.notes: Sample plugin. After install: CloudTAK Settings → Refresh App.

plugins.name: uDash
plugins.description: CloudTAK dashboard plugin with a separate webhook sidecar.

sidecars.note: Also run the repo server/ webhook process. Marketplace does not start that sidecar.

plugins.notes: Sidecar in server/ is not auto-wired. After install: CloudTAK Settings → Refresh App.

plugins.name: Print
plugins.description: Print maps from CloudTAK, plus a separate print API service.

sidecars.note: Deploy service/ Docker and Caddy /print-api. Marketplace does not write Caddy.

plugins.notes: Caddy /print-api snippet is not auto-applied. After install: CloudTAK Settings → Refresh App.

plugins.name: Cellphone / Ping
